caveats: This deliberately restrictive discovery policy is not an enforcement proposal.
Only the HTML report-only header is replaced; backend document bytes and enforcing policies are preserved.
The temporary loopback origin differs from the normal app origin; this capture cannot establish OAuth callback or cookie behavior.
The reused network classifier labels the temporary 127.0.0.1 document as other; same-origin CSP observations use the actual page origin.
Welcome readiness and a bounded observation window do not cover authenticated views, OAuth return, GraphiQL or WebSockets.
Unknown dependency origins become other and require source or interactive inspection before classification is extended.
Network counts include incomplete and failed requests; complete describes the capture sequence, not policy compatibility.
